projects.title: AI-Driven SDLC Automation
projects.objective: Designing and evaluating a multi-agent AI system to simulate Waterfall and Agile SDLC workflows using structured orchestration and role-based LLM collaboration.
bulletPoints: Developed a multi-agent SDLC simulation system assigning AI agents roles such as Product Owner, Scrum Master, Developer, Architect, QA, and Documentation Engineer.
Automated generation of requirements, user stories, sprint backlogs, architecture design, and test cases using GPT-based LLMs.
Implemented and compared Linear, Round-Robin, and Graph-based (LangGraph) orchestration strategies for agent coordination.
Designed prompt-chaining workflows to ensure structured task handoffs between agents.
Evaluated workflow efficiency, task granularity, and coordination overhead across different orchestration frameworks.
Demonstrated realistic simulation of Agile sprint planning and Waterfall requirement documentation using autonomous agent collaboration.
projects.tech: Python, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI GPT, Prompt Engineering

projects.title: Mental Health Signals from Social Media
projects.objective: Analyzing large-scale social media and survey datasets to detect stress patterns using NLP, statistical modeling, and machine learning in R.
bulletPoints: Built a full ML pipeline in R to classify stress vs non-stress posts using the Dreaddit dataset with 80/20 train-test split and SMOTE balancing.
Compared Logistic Regression (GLM), Random Forest, SVM, XGBoost, and Naive Bayes using Accuracy, F1-score, AUC, ROC curves, and confusion matrices.
Performed emotion and sentiment analysis on ~550K+ social media posts using NRC lexicon and Syuzhet to compute stress scores and sentiment polarity.
Engineered behavioral validation models across Students, Bhavik, and SMMH datasets using linear and logistic regression.
Computed odds ratios and confidence intervals to analyze treatment-seeking behavior predictors.
Visualized model performance comparisons, emotion radar charts, correlation heatmaps, and stress distribution plots using ggplot2.
projects.tech: R, tidyverse, caret, pROC, syuzhet, tm, xgboost, kernlab, naivebayes, ggplot2

projects.title: GitHub Issues Analysis & Semantic Search
projects.objective: Building an automated pipeline to ingest, analyze, and semantically search GitHub repository issues using vector embeddings and containerized deployment.
bulletPoints: Retrieved and processed GitHub issue data programmatically using GitHub REST APIs across multiple open-source repositories.
Built data ingestion and transformation pipelines to structure semi-structured JSON issue metadata into analytics-ready datasets.
Generated visualizations to analyze issue trends, creation vs closure patterns, and repository activity metrics.
Created vector embeddings for issue content and stored them in ElasticSearch indices for semantic retrieval.
Implemented similarity-based search to retrieve Top-5 most relevant issues per query using embedding scores.
Containerized the application using Docker to enable reproducible execution and simplified deployment.
projects.tech: Python, GitHub API, ElasticSearch, OpenAI Embeddings, Docker, Pandas, Matplotlib

projects.title: Churn Prediction
projects.objective: Developing an end-to-end machine learning pipeline to predict customer churn using structured banking data and comparative model evaluation.
bulletPoints: Built a complete ML pipeline to predict customer churn using 10,000+ structured banking records with feature preprocessing and encoding.
Performed exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify key churn drivers including tenure, balance, geography, and activity status.
Trained and compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, SVM, and XGBoost models using cross-validation.
Handled class imbalance and optimized hyperparameters to improve model generalization performance.
Evaluated models using Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, Confusion Matrix, and ROC-AUC.
Selected XGBoost as the best-performing model for imbalanced churn prediction based on AUC and F1-score metrics.
projects.tech: Python, Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Matplotlib, Seaborn
